T14.removed: the viewport shrank for the keyboard (visualViewport.height < 0.8 x screen.height)
T14.why: Timing-sensitive and not the real condition. In 8B prod run #2 it failed (839 of 915 CSS px) while the screenshot showed NO soft keyboard at all: the emulator had show_ime_with_hard_keyboard = 0, so adb input counted as a hardware keyboard and no keyboard was ever drawn. A shrinking viewport neither proves a keyboard is drawn nor that the field is visible.
added: keyboard opens: dumpsys input_method mInputShown=true AND dumpsys window reports a VISIBLE IME frame (its top edge in screen px is recorded)
the keyboard is DRAWN on the screenshot: the screen band below the IME top differs strongly from the same band before the tap (mean absolute grey difference > 12)
the input is fully visible: below the sticky header, above the fixed tab bar and above the keyboard top in real screen pixels, and not covered (elementFromPoint at 4 corners + centre hits the input)
kept: a query known to have results
T14.emulator: show_ime_with_hard_keyboard is now set to 1 by scripts/android/avd-setup.sh and again at the start of T14 / K1
